name: Sakura Tanaka
bio:
Sakura Tanaka's fascination with motorsport began during her university days, captivated by the complex electronics systems powering Formula 1 cars. After graduating with a degree in electrical engineering from the University of Tokyo, she started her career at a major Japanese automotive manufacturer, focusing on hybrid powertrain development. Seeking a more dynamic environment, she transitioned to motorsport, initially working with a Super GT team before eventually joining Rahal Letterman Lanigan Racing.

Sakura's approach to electronics engineering is rooted in meticulous analysis and a deep understanding of system integration. She believes in leveraging data to optimize performance and reliability, always seeking innovative solutions to push the boundaries of what's possible. Her visionary perspective allows her to anticipate potential problems and develop proactive solutions, making her a valuable asset to the team. Her experience with Japanese manufacturing techniques has been an asset to the American racing team.

What sets Sakura apart is her ability to see the bigger picture. She doesn't just focus on individual components but understands how they interact within the entire vehicle system. This holistic approach, combined with her unwavering commitment to excellence, has earned her a reputation as a highly respected and sought-after electronics engineer in the racing world.
